description: This PHP source file defines a REST API controller named SystemCheckAPI, which is part of the installer’s upgrader module in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract controller and exposes an endpoint to perform a system check by invoking methods from the SystemCheck utility class, returning the results and status as a JSON response.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for performing system checks during installation or upgrade processes.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to perform a system check and returns the results as an array.
